graph.title: Swamp Police Starter Set

new_part_types.name: Antenna / control stick with yellow base

notes: The booklet builds several separate models: the police airboat with the ranger, the robbers' raft with two robbers, the swamp island with the woman and snake, and the crocodile. The four separate groups in the graph are therefore intentional. Nothing in the booklet attaches one model to another.

lego-74156 (two yellow-based antennas/control sticks, boat step 14) is kept as printed on the inventory page. The booklet prints the number 74156 and the full 7-digit element ID cannot be read from the page, so the part was kept rather than invented. It may need correcting if the exact element ID is found.
Ids were matched to the inventory page by picture and step order. Element IDs not in the catalogue were added as new types. Their ports are best guesses.
The inventory does not say which head ID (6103921, 6100203, 6112620, 6018687) belongs to which minifigure; the assignment is a guess.

Minifigure joints (head to torso, hat to head, legs, beard, sack, hand grips) use null ports because the catalogue port kinds are not mutually compatible. Where a catalogue part exposes only one stud or anti-stud port (for example the 4x4 swamp base plate and several 1x4 bricks) but several parts attach to it, the extra edges also use null ports.

Boat: stud positions are inferred. The white inverted slope sits on the hull behind the black plates. The bracket, clip plates and seat sit on the black plates and bracket. The fan guard and pin plate attach to the bracket's back face, and the propeller goes on the pin. Which clip plate holds the binoculars and which the walkie-talkie is a guess.

Raft: built as a stack of plate, log brick, round logs plus tan brick, log brick, round logs plus tan brick, log brick, plate. Both robbers stand on the top plate. One oar is held by robber 1 and the other lies on the raft. The cover art shows robber 2 on the island, but step 8 shows him on the raft, so the step 8 placement was used.

Swamp island: part 4271949 is a tile in the catalogue but must carry the plant leaves, so a stud connection is assumed. The money tile lies on it. The snake and the woman only rest beside the island and are not fastened to it.
Crocodile: tail, body and head are modelled as hinge joints, with the blue pin pivoting the head. This is a guess from the pictures.

graph_initial.title: Swamp Police Starter Set

new_part_types.name: Antenna / control stick with yellow base

notes: The booklet contains several separate models: the police airboat (steps 1-17), the robbers' raft (steps 1-8), the swamp island (steps 1-8), the crocodile (steps 1-3) and four minifigures (pages 3-4). All are in one graph.

Instruction pages show pictures only; ids were matched to inventory element IDs by picture and step order. Element IDs not in the catalogue were added as new types (inventory page 31). Port choices for these are best guesses.

The inventory does not say which of the four head IDs (6103921, 6100203, 6112620, 6018687) belongs to which minifig; the assignment is a guess. The ranger head uses lego-6018687, which is in the catalogue.

Boat: exact stud positions are inferred. The white inverted slope (b4) is assumed to sit on the hull studs behind the black plates. The bracket, clip plates and seat attach to the black plates and bracket. The fan guard and pin plate are assumed to attach to the bracket's back face; the propeller goes on the pin. The two clip plates (b10, b11) are assumed to hold the binoculars and walkie-talkie, but the assignment is a guess.

Raft: it is built as a stack of plate, log brick, round logs and tan brick, log brick, round logs and tan brick, log brick, plate. Step 8 shows it turned over; both robbers are assumed to stand on the top plate. One oar is held by robber 1 and the other lies on the raft. The cover art shows robber 2 on the swamp island, but step 8 shows him on the raft, so the step 8 placement was used.

Swamp island: the part 4271949 is listed as a tile in the catalogue but must hold the plant leaves, so its stud connection is assumed. The loose money tile lies on it. The snake and the woman minifigure only rest beside the island and are not fastened to it.
Crocodile: tail, body and head are modelled as hinge joints, with the blue pin pivoting the head. This is a guess from the pictures.
